page: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-28 is a memory-dense instance in the Network Optimized family built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 28 dedicated vCPUs paired with 372 GB of system memory, providing approximately 13.29 GB of RAM per vCPU. This high memory-to-core allocation is tailored for workloads that require substantial working sets without necessitating excessive vCPU counts.

The instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, featuring zero local disks and zero GPUs. As a result, persistent data retention and high-throughput input/output rely entirely on external network-attached block storage solutions. In addition, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default, requiring network routing via private addresses, cloud NAT, or separately provisioned public IPs.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high RAM-to-CPU ratio makes this configuration economical for memory-bound tasks that do not scale linearly with CPU capacity. Operating without local storage eliminates peripheral overheads for environments centered purely on in-memory compute. Recommended workloads include large in-memory key-value stores, in-memory relational databases, real-time analytics engines, enterprise resource planning systems, and complex caching tiers.
description: Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-28 is an x86_64 cloud instance from the Network Optimized family configured with 28 dedicated vCPUs and 372 GB of system memory. Operating at a ratio of approximately 13.29 GB of memory per core, the system accommodates massive operational datasets within RAM. The instance does not include dedicated graphics processors or bundled local storage volumes, delegating persistence and scratch storage to network-attached block devices. Additionally, complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included with the virtual machine. Economically aligned with RAM-constrained architectures, this tier prevents overprovisioning core counts to acquire necessary system memory. Google Cloud Platform m4n-megamem-28 is suitable for running in-memory databases, memory-resident data caches, business intelligence processing, distributed data processing nodes, and large enterprise applications.
